    p."PLT_KIND",
    ROUND(AVG(
        0.3 * i."TopCoh" +
        0.3 * i."TxtUniq" +
        0.4 * i."ConvNat"
    )::numeric, 2) AS typical_content_authenticity_score
FROM accounts a
JOIN platforms p ON a.plt_key = p."PLT_CODE"
JOIN interaction_metrics i ON i.acct_dm = a.acct_ref
GROUP BY p."PLT_KIND"
ORDER BY p."PLT_KIND";
